## Complete candidate only

Problem 30004324 / OWR-17296-007, queue rank 746. This draft records a complete AI-audited candidate proof, **not** an accepted resolution, human peer review, formal proof verification, or a historical-novelty claim. External specialist review and priority verification remain pending.

The full hypotheses are unchanged: X is a smooth integral projective variety of dimension n >= 1 over an algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic, and the tangent-bundle Seshadri constant is positive at one arbitrary closed point. The proposed conclusion is X isomorphic to projective n-space.

## Proof and review

The candidate uses an absolute pointed ample-degree minimum to remove all stable-map boundary, very-free normalizations through the fixed point, an inertia-free actual evaluation fiber finite over the full projective coarse scheme, and a genuine P1-family with contracted marking. Surjective evaluation and fiberwise degree-zero line-bundle descent yield Picard number one and Fano; the established Fulger–Murayama Fano clause finishes the proposed characterization.

Two independent AI geometry audits found no essential gap. The independent final v2 delta audit returned PASS for proof, tooling, and exact frozen bytes. Imported standard foundations are explicit; the full Kollár monograph proof was not independently retrieved.

Read [the publication guide](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/8edfe0bf37d07814c5503107b9029e506b6046ea/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004324/README.md), [v2 candidate](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/8edfe0bf37d07814c5503107b9029e506b6046ea/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004324/tangent_seshadri_30004324_v2/candidate_proof.md), and [final delta acceptance](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/8edfe0bf37d07814c5503107b9029e506b6046ea/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004324/tangent_seshadri_30004324_v2_delta_acceptance/DELTA_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## Integrity history and preservation

- Preserve original author ZIP and v2 ZIP byte-for-byte, the exact 124,052-byte v1-to-v2 patch, both independent original audit manifests/layouts, and the separate delta acceptance.
- Retain the original verifier's **REVISE_REQUIRED** nested-MANIFEST bypass finding. The v2 strict verifier controls; old code remains only for regression demonstration.
- Frozen v2 strings saying delta review is pending are historical. The separate acceptance supplies the later outcome for the exact pinned bytes; frozen files are untouched.
- Both complete geometry reports are already verbatim in v2; audit layouts reconstruct exact original packages without redundant copies.

## Checks

Local and exact-head remote normal, optimized, relocated, and zero-fuzz-patched replays pass. All 50 changed files, including both binary ZIPs, were read back from head 8edfe0bf37d07814c5503107b9029e506b6046ea and matched byte-for-byte; the full remote packet was replayed independently of the working copy. These include 909,136 author and 85,247 independent finite controls, 14 strict integrity mutations, the historical regression, independent audit reconstruction, and exact patch regeneration. An additional 13 publication-wrapper mutations were rejected in normal and optimized modes. These checks do not prove the geometry. Zero check runs, statuses, and workflow runs were observed for the exact head; this is not a CI pass.

## Scope

Only the target queue row's Status, Turns, and Findings change to candidate-only `claimed_solved, 2/5`; Chat, DOI, the stale embedded header, every other cell, and all other queue bytes are preserved. Authored proof/code/audit and public verification metadata only; no source PDFs/extracts, raw dataset, private sources, or private coordination files. No merge, release, DOI, or external outreach.
